text: The milk is separated, the skim part is pushed through a membrane that holds back the proteins, and the cream and the minerals that went through are put back, so the milk keeps its fat and gets denser in protein.

steps.note: Cold, through a membrane that holds back the proteins (80 % casein, 20 % whey) and fat and passes water, lactose and some minerals.

steps.name: return minerals
steps.note: The lactose-rich stream is split again by nanofiltration and reverse osmosis, and the minerals go back.
For the lactose left over; it is on the label.
